concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: standalone logo symbol for ForeverPin, a consumer product for lasting programmable links and QR codes. The reference image is the current logo, supplied for category recognition and violet identity, not a composition to copy. Produce one original polished flat vector-like symbol only, no text or wordmark. Ink: solid uniform violet #7040d7. Actual transparent background including internal cutouts. Contemporary confident rounded geometry, controlled corner radius, thick readable forms, open negative space. Target a roughly 24-unit symbol grid; internal spacing starts near 1/24 of the visible maximum extent, with optical adjustment. The identity must work alone, beside a wordmark, and on an app tile, so do NOT include any carrier, enclosing background tile, mockup, border, shadow, gradient, texture, bevel, highlights or presentation labels. Center a single upright symbol with generous transparent margins, occupying roughly 72% of the canvas. Make the artwork sophisticated and compact, not cute or toy-like. No micro-dots, no random QR speckles, no tiny decorative bits, no working/scannable QR, no infinity inside a map pin, no multicolor. Keep all solid interiors uniformly opaque. Concept: ROUTED QR. Preserve the immediate three-eye QR reading of the reference while making a proprietary, simpler emblem. Three large equal rounded-square finder loops at upper left, upper right, and lower left; each has a generous rounded-square negative-space center and bold substantial walls. In the lower-right quadrant use one beautiful thick continuous right-angle routing bend, with rounded corners and blunt rounded terminals, expressing a destination that can change. Exactly four primary components, no scattered dots. The routing bend should balance the finder eyes, not read as punctuation. Stable square overall silhouette, slightly softened outer and inner corners. Strong, elegant, easy to recognize at small sizes.
